Every virtual instance you quickly install in your Seeweb cloud environment can easily be migrated to a bigger plan and combined with cloud backup solutions and security services such as firewall, VPN etc. The entire infrastructure is protected by anti dDosS systems for free. Ideal also for short projects thanks to the pay-as-you-go billing.

Select from the admin panel where to activate your Shared CPU cloud servers: the Data Centers available are Frosinone, Milan, Lugano, Zurich.

The ideal virtual server for developers

Cloud Server Shared CPU allows developers to access a web server, DB server, and computing environment with the ability to integrate the infrastructure network with any other service in the Seeweb range.

Additionally, it is possible to activate instant VM snapshots or schedule them on a weekly basis.

Our cloud service dedicated to web developers also enables cost optimization by reserving your virtual machines for multiple months.

Cloud Server Shared CPU: Launch Your Instances Securely

You can activate Cloud Server Shared CPU by choosing from multiple European data centers located in Italy, Switzerland, and Bulgaria. These locations ensure a GDPR-compliant environment, making them ideal for applications and projects developed for businesses and public administrations with high privacy requirements. Resource isolation further enhances security, ensuring stable and reliable performance even on shared infrastructure.

Enable Your Preferred Management and Security Options

Customize your Cloud Server Shared CPU instances with the level of support and data protection that best aligns with your project’s needs. From Basic Support to Proactive, you can rely on us for routine VM maintenance or entrust us with full, proactive management of your virtual architecture.

For data security, you can take advantage of remote snapshots, allowing you to store VM backups in a different data center from the primary one. You can also add an extra layer of protection by choosing a Backup as a Service solution, such as Cloud Backup or Cloud Data Protection.

Simplify Your Cloud Environment

The new control panel allows you to manage your entire infrastructure intuitively and efficiently. With advanced tools like API Tokens and Cloud Script, you can automate repetitive tasks and tailor your virtual environment to your specific needs.

Unlock Significant Cloud Cost Benefits

Directly from the panel, you can reserve VM resources for 3, 6, or 12 months, gaining access to progressive discounts of up to 20%. This feature is ideal for long-term projects and stable infrastructures, helping you significantly optimize your cloud spending.
